idea-plugin.name: Pi Agent Selection
idea-plugin.description:
Integrates the Pi coding agent with your IDE: the current editor selection is automatically injected as context when you submit a prompt in Pi — no copy-pasting.

How it works
• The plugin runs a localhost-only service that tracks the active editor selection in real time (in memory, nothing written to disk)
• When you submit a prompt in Pi, a companion Pi extension fetches the current selection over HTTP and injects it as <idea-selection> context
• The same selection is injected only once; picking a new selection switches the context automatically; cancelling the selection stops injection
• A WebSocket channel keeps Pi's status widget updated with the current selection file and lines

Requirements
A Pi coding agent installation — the companion extension is deployed automatically by this plugin.

Notes
• Listens on 127.0.0.1 only (ports 19232+), no external network access
• Per-project service: multiple IDE windows / instances are fully isolated (port auto-allocation, discovered via ~/.pi/ide lock files)
• Installs and keeps the companion Pi extension up to date automatically (~/.pi/agent/extensions/)
• 兼容 Pi Agent：提交 prompt 自动注入 IDEA 当前选中代码，无需复制粘贴；Pi 侧扩展随插件自动部署
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.3.0:
• Right-click actions: Send to Pi (pushes the selection/file reference straight into your running pi session's input box) and Copy Reference (@path#L16-23) — in editor, project view and editor tab menus
• With multiple pi sessions, references go to the most recently active one
• pi extension expands @path#Lx-y references into code blocks on submit
• New plugin logo
1.2.0:
• Auto-deploy: the Pi-side extension is bundled in the plugin and installed/updated to ~/.pi/agent/extensions/ automatically on IDE startup (old copy backed up as .bak)
1.1.0:
• Multi-IDE isolation: one service per project window, port auto-allocation (19232+2i), lock-file discovery in ~/.pi/ide/
• Pi extension picks the server whose project matches its working directory (falls back to most recently active)
1.0.0:
• Initial release
• Real-time selection tracking (event-source editor, works with split editors and multiple projects)
• HTTP query + WebSocket push on auto-allocated ports (19232+2i / 19233+2i per project window)
• Pull-based injection: Pi extension fetches the current selection at prompt time, no stale context
